name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.order_count_nonnegative
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → 0 ≤ M5.OrderCount.C N w F
guidance: Split on divisibility and use27 C_nonnegative or the cutoff C=0. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.
